# Ascend.com

> Ascend.com is an elite-level .com domain that is for sale. It is being brokered by ATM Holdings. It was previously owned by Nokia and was registered in 1990.

## Key facts

- Domain: Ascend.com (one dictionary word, six letters, .com)
- Status: for sale / available to acquire
- Broker: ATM Holdings — https://atmholdings.com/
- Previous owner: Nokia
- Registered: 1990
- Enquiries: AMiller@atmholdings.com (subject: "Domain Inquiry for Ascend.com")
- Price: not published; handled directly by the broker

## Suitable industries

"Ascend" means to rise, climb or improve, so the name is not tied to one category. It suits finance and wealth management, fintech and payments, aviation and aerospace, health and fitness, education and learning, software and AI, real estate and property, careers and recruiting, travel and outdoor, venture capital and start-ups, consulting and leadership, and energy and sustainability.
